headline: American-Ukrainian investment fund signs first deal in the "critical minerals" sector - media
summary: The Ukraine Recovery Fund signed its first critical minerals deal with BGV Group and launched four more projects. Total investments reached $70 million, according to media reports.
why: The Ukraine Recovery Fund is a US-Ukrainian vehicle investing in Ukrainian reconstruction and resources, and critical minerals are inputs for batteries, electronics and defence products.
